legacyContent.summary: A Hebrews 3:7–19 sermon presenting the wilderness generation as a warning to Christians. Israel hardened their hearts and failed to enter the promised rest because they did not trust God to the end. Christians are warned to beware of hardened hearts, exhort one another daily, abide in Christ, and hold fast.
legacyContent.keyEmphasis: The wilderness generation is an example of what Christians must not do; continued faithfulness and holding fast are presented as necessary.
closingResponse: Believe that Jesus is the Messiah
